principles.hierarchy: Task and evidence first; supporting provenance and runtime details available on demand.
principles.tone: Quiet dark research workspace, cyan reserved for primary action and selected state.
principles.density: Fewer competing card borders, clear section separation and readable long Chinese text.
principles.mobile: Compact header, complete accessible navigation, responsive controls and no body overflow.

protected_interfaces: DOM IDs used for actual user actions
owner: main design integration; modules implemented by three disjoint subagents

before_after_reproducibility.purpose: reproduce the previous visual layout for screenshot comparison on social

review_sheet_scope: Six real baseline viewport screenshots, original app data; used for side-by-side visual review after redesign.

findings_confirmed: tiny uniform metadata text makes hierarchy weak
manual grouping editor pushes related candidates below the fold
version status cards dominate changes page
recommendation cards read as schema documentation
topic materials start after multiple boxed control groups
main_baseline_review.guidance: Prioritize task/result, reduce nested surfaces, balance text sizes and keep advanced details accessible.

shared_mobile_validation.notes: Scope-only shared CSS; final redesigned modules still require integrated QA.

main_assistant_preview_review.scope: source-injection preview, not final encrypted acceptance
main_assistant_preview_review.verdict: Accepted for central integration: composer is clear, examples are organized, scope folds on narrow screens, and primary action fits the initial phone viewport. Filled-answer and citation behavior require the integrated independent run.

main_projects_preview_review.verdict: Accepted for integration: mobile selected project and material/report actions precede folder list; desktop report sits beside materials; empty composition has a clear next action. Final encrypted backup, focus and responsive checks remain with independent QA.

main_research_preview_review.verdict: Accepted for encrypted integration: original/translation text is readable, candidate material precedes grouping editor, and task controls sit beside concise plan summaries. Research workspace uses a consistent visual hierarchy. Independent final after phase remains the release gate.

main_final_encrypted_visual_review.findings: The actual built views reproduce the reviewed hierarchy and spacing. Mobile composer/send and project workspace controls are visible without the old long preamble. Changes results now precede technical metadata. No new visual fix requested for these views.

final_density_refinement.main_visual_verdict: accepted; reading content begins sooner without reducing type or column width

independent_final_acceptance.final_css_refinement: Only evidence desktop spacing changed; affected actual encrypted checks repeated with earlier behavior provenance retained.
